Hi Elena — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and one scheduling question below.

Recap (short):
- Primary use case: customer support summarization and agent-assist for transactions at scale (~6M monthly messages).
- Success metric: 30% reduction in average handle time and sub-300ms P95 latencies for UI calls to the model.
- Data concerns: logs must be retained per your policy; redwood private deployment and KMS options discussed.
- Integrations: plan is to start with the Zendesk connector and evaluate an embeddings pipeline for sem-search.

Open question for your team: do you have an internal budget window or procurement cycle we should aim for in Q3/Q4? If there's a purchase target date (or a hard budget freeze coming), it helps us prioritize a dedicated pilot vs. a hosted PoC.

Next steps I proposed on the call:
- 30-min technical session with your infra/ops folks (options: Tue 9/6 10am PT or Wed 9/7 2pm PT).
- Share a one-page SOW and a sample pilot plan (attached).

I've attached a short discovery recap and a pricing summary to use with procurement. If the timeframe is shifting, a quick reply with the month (e.g., "Nov budget window") is perfect.

Attachments: 2027-08-30-cobaltpay-discovery-recap.pdf, redwood-pricing-summary-Q3.xlsx

Thanks —
